manifest.description: Move an Elixir module from one umbrella apps/<src>/ to another apps/<dst>/ via elixir_move_module_across_apps. Emits FileMove + advisory mix.exs edits + config_references report.
when_to_use: an umbrella project needs a module reassigned to a different app
consolidation pass after an app split where modules ended up in the wrong app
anti_patterns: do not use on non-umbrella projects (refused with source_not_in_apps_lib)
do not use when config files dynamically synthesize module names with Module.concat (refused with config_dynamic)
do not expect auto-edit of mix.exs — the atom reports proposed deps changes; operator applies manually

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-move-across-apps.

Protocol:
1. bbox_refactor_plan(kind="elixir_move_module_across_apps", source="{{source}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}", toml_entries={"target_app": "{{target_app}}", "target_path_in_app": "{{target_path_in_app}}", "acknowledge_app_boundary_crossing": {{acknowledge_app_boundary_crossing}}}).
2. Surface cross_app_dependencies, mix_exs_edits (advisory), config_references.
3. Refuse on source_not_in_apps_lib / cyclical_app_dependency / config_dynamic.
4. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<moved_module + advisory edits + config refs>).

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{target_app}} {{target_path_in_app}} {{acknowledge_app_boundary_crossing}}
